66:3914.en: 「If I bust those $$インプラント$$ rounds!」

66:3949.en: 「Damn that Galaxy bunch,\nwhat do they think hearts are...!」

66:4100.en: 「This is the land you longed for.\nDying here should satisfy you!」

66:4159.en: 「We won't let you rule the galaxy!」

66:4229.en: 「Like the $$バジュラ$$, they have hearts?!」

66:4873.en: 「$$アンタレス$$ 1, I'll back you up!」

66:5242.en: 「Not yet! I won't lose to someone\nwho can't even get their heart back!」

66:5105.en: 「If you're $$ランカ$$'s brother,\nstop making $$ランカ$$ sad!」

66:5016.en: 「You can call me Big Bro, $$ブレラ$$.」

67:1692.en: 「I fight you as a Federation soldier!」

67:1790.en: 「We surely have the right to carve\nout our own fate with our own hands!」

67:1855.en: 「You will be defeated by\nthe possibility humanity holds!」

69:2573.en: 「I'll defeat you and free the Earth!」

69:2608.en: 「This is the rage of the people\nyou made suffer!」

69:2657.en: 「You are the root of all despair!」

69:6431.en: 「Let's go, $$シュレード$$...! Best Friend Union! GO! Aquariooon!!」

71:1874.en: 「I can't stand being looked\ndown on from up high!」

71:1966.en: 「Like I'd lose to bastards\nwho don't even know love!!」

73:225.en: 「$$シロッコ$$! If it weren't for you!!」

73:3341.en: 「I can't believe I have to use this!」

75:3903.en: 「I can't ignore someone about\nto repeat the same mistake!」

75:3956.en: 「You're just like me, aren't you?\nYou can't accept the times...」

75:4379.en: 「I'll free the Earth from your hands!」

75:4416.en: 「You are beings at odds\nwith the Heart of Space!」

75:4465.en: 「The Heart of Space told me.\nHope lies beyond this battle!」

75:212.en: 「So you'll get in my way!\nThen... you die!」

75:2103.en:
「If this were a fight to take
lives, it'd be over already! But
then what would be the point
of us coming here at all?」

75:2210.en: 「Isn't that fine?\n$$トロワ$$ can just be $$トロワ$$...」

77:2439.en: 「So that's the $$インプラント$$ round...!」

77:2581.en: 「Never thought we'd end up\nfighting $$バトル・フロンティア$$...!」

77:2642.en: 「Even fused with the $$女王バジュラ$$,\nyou won't intimidate me!」

77:2746.en: 「We nearly committed a sin too...!\nTo atone for it, right now!」

77:2821.en: 「Judging them by having no brain...\nwas jumping the gun.」

77:3156.en: 「$$アンタレス$$ 1, fall back behind me!」

79:0.en: 「Infamous across $$ジーハ村$$, $$グレン団$$! A man's soul on my back! Unyielding, indomitable! The, uh, demon leader!」

79:120.en: 「Yeah, goodbye for real now! Go, bro!」

80:3186.en: 「We understood the $$プロトデビルン$$!\nWe can understand you too!」

80:4138.en: 「For all who love peace and freedom,\nwe fight!」

80:4189.en: 「I think I know how\nterrifying a $$スフィア$$ is...!」

80:4240.en: 「Whatever your circumstances,\nright now we just fight!」

80:4291.en: 「Here I come, $$御使い$$...!\nListen to my sooong!!」

80:1949.en: 「Sing...! Above all, sing in $$バサラ$$'s place!」

82:1182.en: 「However hard you hold us down,\nwe'll fight!」

82:526.en: 「I'm good at this kind of thing too!」
